Rajasthan Computer Instructor Provisional Answer Key Released

The Rajasthan Subordinate Services Selection Board (RSSB) has released the provisional answer key for the Computer Instructor recruitment examination. Candidates who appeared for the exam can download the answer key from the official website. The release of the provisional answer key allows candidates to review the answers and raise objections if they find any discrepancies. Further details regarding the objection process and the final answer key will be announced by the board.
